title: docs(pm): dispatch-gates header states the battery's cap basis as its sibling does
body:
Fixes #18288

## What changed

`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`'s header comment, in the "## Run --self-test
DETACHED on an agent container" section, stated the pre-memoisation basis for
the detach prescription: the battery "makes the full run longer than the
container's foreground command cap, which SIGTERMs a run past it" — true
before the family-discovery memoisation, no longer the measured basis today.

The clause now matches the corrected basis its sibling `check-dispatch-gates.mjs`
carries at :43-:48 (added after #18201 collapsed the battery's own
tree-discovery to one pass per process): the battery is cap-SIZED on a quiet
box — the cap belongs to the CALLER's container and the margin to how
contended it is, neither of which this file can see, and an agent box runs
several agents at once. The prescription is unchanged: detach and poll the
log (`tail --pid` or otherwise); a timeout is not a reading.

Section shape, the `nohup`/`tail` example command, and the `#14281` reference
are all kept as-is; only the outdated basis clause is rewritten.

## Comment-only, no behaviour change

    git diff origin/main -- scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs | grep -E '^[-+]' | grep -v -E '^(\+\+\+|---)' | grep -v -E '^[-+]\s*\*'

prints nothing on this branch — every changed line is a ` * ` comment line.

## Measured

This run's own `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates`: 434.5s, 1730 cases pass, no
cap-kill — one more point alongside the six already on the register row this
reading is drawn from (432.4 / 433.3 / 434.8 / 435.7 / 447.4 / 450.2s, all
verdicts, none a cap-kill; see PR #18287's fold of `platform-readings.md`).
